propositions: Add nested bridge CLI group with only preview and sync verbs, routing through shared reconciler subprocess launcher while preserving legacy top-level command names
Preview verb forces dry-run mode and performs zero writes to Jira, ticket state, or bridge state; sync verb forces live mode and performs persisted mutations
Reject --mode, --filter-local-ids, and arbitrary trailing arguments on both verbs to prevent override of read/write semantics

Unknown nested verbs fail with valid choices and never dispatch same-named top-level commands; help output excludes internal vocabulary (mode, rank, gate, lock, cap, pass, binding store, numeric exit codes)
Preserve Mode, MODE_CAPS, gated_mode round trip, and all legacy bridge command spellings (reconcile, jira-onboard, bridge-probe, bridge-fsck, doctor)
Generate nested group in CLI reference and staged documentation (cli-reference.md, exit-codes.md, user-guide.md, release-notes.md) only for the functional surface that ships
